# IMP3RIAL EDU

IMP3RIAL EDU is a next-generation multi-tenant school operating system. It provides an end-to-end platform for academic grading, real-time attendance tracking, proctored Computer-Based Testing (CBT) exams, tuition tracking, and a dedicated parent portal for monitoring student progress.

Main URL: https://edu.imp3rial.dev
